Test move declaration refactoring: moves between non-test and test files, and
between test files, for both in-package tests (package src) and external tests
(package src_test).

The test directories are named so as to specify the type of src/dest in the move:

n: a normal, non-test file (package a, a.go)
i: an internal test file (package a, a_test.go)
x: an external test file (package a_test, a_test.go)

e.g. n2x is a move from package src, src.go -> package src_test, src_test.go.

-- capabilities.json --
{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --
{
	"analyses": {"unusedfunc": false}
}

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests

go 1.20

-- n2x/src/src.go --
package src

// Helper is used only by the external test, so it can move there.
func Helper() int { return 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/n2x/src/src_test.go"}`, result=n2x)

// Used is used by non-test code (User() in this file), which cannot import the external test package.
func Used() int { return 2 } //@codeaction(re"Used", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/n2x/src/src_test.go"}`, err=re"import cycle")

func User() int { return Used() }

-- n2x/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests/n2x/src"
)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = src.Helper() }

-- @n2x/n2x/src/src.go --
package src

// Used is used by non-test code (User() in this file), which cannot import the external test package.
func Used() int { return 2 } //@codeaction(re"Used", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/n2x/src/src_test.go"}`, err=re"import cycle")

func User() int { return Used() }

-- @n2x/n2x/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	
)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = Helper() }

// Helper is used only by the external test, so it can move there.
func Helper() int { return 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/n2x/src/src_test.go"}`, result=n2x)
-- x2n/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests/x2n/src"
)

// Helper moves from the external test package into package src.
func Helper() int { return src.Base() + 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2n/src/src.go"}`, result=x2n)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = Helper() + src.Base() }

-- x2n/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

-- @x2n/x2n/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

// Helper moves from the external test package into package src.
func Helper() int { return Base() + 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2n/src/src.go"}`, result=x2n)
-- @x2n/x2n/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests/x2n/src"
)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = src.Helper() + src.Base() }

-- i2n/src/src_test.go --
package src

import "testing"

// helper moves from an in-package test file into a non-test file. Its
// dependency helper2 is declared in a test file, which non-test code cannot
// see, so it moves too.
func helper() int { return helper2() + Base() } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/i2n/src/src.go"}`, result=i2n)

func helper2() int { return 1 }

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() + helper2() }

-- i2n/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

-- @i2n/i2n/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

// helper moves from an in-package test file into a non-test file. Its
// dependency helper2 is declared in a test file, which non-test code cannot
// see, so it moves too.
func helper() int { return helper2() + Base() } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/i2n/src/src.go"}`, result=i2n)

func helper2() int { return 1 }
-- @i2n/i2n/src/src_test.go --
package src

import "testing"

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() + helper2() }

-- x2i/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

-- x2i/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests/x2i/src"
)

// Helper moves from the external test package into an in-package test file.
// The external test can still use it, as src.Helper.
func Helper() int { return src.Base() + 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2i/src/dest_test.go"}`, result=x2i)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = Helper() + src.Base() }

-- x2i/src/dest_test.go --
package src

import "testing"

func TestDest(t *testing.T) {}

-- @x2i/x2i/src/dest_test.go --
package src

import "testing"

func TestDest(t *testing.T) {}

// Helper moves from the external test package into an in-package test file.
// The external test can still use it, as src.Helper.
func Helper() int { return Base() + 1 } //@codeaction(re"Helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2i/src/dest_test.go"}`, result=x2i)
-- @x2i/x2i/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/lsptests/movedecltests/x2i/src"
)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = src.Helper() + src.Base() }

-- x2x/src/src.go --
package src

func Base() int { return 1 }

-- x2x/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import "testing"

// helper moves between files of the external test package: a same-package
// move, so helper2 does not move with it.
func helper() int { return helper2() } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2x/src/dest_test.go"}`, result=x2x)

func helper2() int { return 1 }

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() + helper2() }

-- x2x/src/dest_test.go --
package src_test

import "testing"

func TestDest(t *testing.T) {}

-- @x2x/x2x/src/dest_test.go --
package src_test

import "testing"

func TestDest(t *testing.T) {}

// helper moves between files of the external test package: a same-package
// move, so helper2 does not move with it.
func helper() int { return helper2() } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/x2x/src/dest_test.go"}`, result=x2x)
-- @x2x/x2x/src/src_test.go --
package src_test

import "testing"

func helper2() int { return 1 }

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() + helper2() }

-- testonly/src_test.go --
package testonly

import "testing"

// helper is declared in a directory that contains only _test.go files, so
// there is no non-test package for the new destination file to join. Moving
// it to a new test or non-test file in the same directory is a same-package move.
func helper() int { return 1 } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest_test.go"}`, result=testonly_new_test_file), codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest.go"}`, result=testonly_new_nontest_file)

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() }

-- @testonly_new_nontest_file/testonly/dest.go --
package testonly

// helper is declared in a directory that contains only _test.go files, so
// there is no non-test package for the new destination file to join. Moving
// it to a new test or non-test file in the same directory is a same-package move.
func helper() int { return 1 } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest_test.go"}`, result=testonly_new_test_file), codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest.go"}`, result=testonly_new_nontest_file)
-- @testonly_new_nontest_file/testonly/src_test.go --
package testonly

import "testing"

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() }

-- @testonly_new_test_file/testonly/dest_test.go --
package testonly

// helper is declared in a directory that contains only _test.go files, so
// there is no non-test package for the new destination file to join. Moving
// it to a new test or non-test file in the same directory is a same-package move.
func helper() int { return 1 } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest_test.go"}`, result=testonly_new_test_file), codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly/dest.go"}`, result=testonly_new_nontest_file)
-- @testonly_new_test_file/testonly/src_test.go --
package testonly

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() }

-- testonly_deps/src_test.go --
package testonly

import "testing"

// As above, but helper depends on helper2, which is declared in a test file.
func helper() int { return helper2() } //@codeaction(re"helper", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/testonly_deps/dest_test.go"}`, result=testonly_deps_test_file)

func helper2() int { return 1 }

func TestHelper(t *testing.T) { _ = helper() }
-- @testonly_deps_test_file/testonly_deps/dest_test.go --

// As above, but helper depends on helper2, which is declared in a test file.

-- @testonly_deps_test_file/testonly_deps/src_test.go --
package testonly

import "testing"

func helper2() int { return 1 }
